description: This file defines the 'Details' feature of the Users module, including a request query, its validator, and a handler that fetches user details from a database, maps the data, and generates a JWT token.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents the request query containing the username whose details are to be retrieved.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request by fetching the user from the database, mapping it, generating a token, and returning the user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the user details request asynchronously, retrieves user data, handles not found cases, maps the data, generates a token, and returns the user envelope.
